name: synthesis
description: Drug synthesis: cook reagents into potency-scaled drugs via a chemistry skill check + a 'stabilize the reaction' minigame. Raw→processed cooks require a real chem lab (station quality adds a bonus); no portable kit.

cook.note: KNOWN GAP: needs a chem-lab furniture (flags.crafting_station, a flag value not a tag, so availableActions can't surface it). Plain command, not examine-surfaced.

synthesize.note: KNOWN GAP: alias of cook; same flag gate.

splice.note: KNOWN GAP: master tier; requires a real chem-lab furniture + >=2 drug items + a Stabilizer. Flag-gated furniture, plain command — not examine-surfaced.
